propositions: A Jira issue's KEY changes when moved between projects, but its numeric ID is immutable; bindings keyed on the mutable KEY can silently detach when the old key stops resolving due to incomplete moved_issue_key table updates on Data Center.

The remediation captures and stores the numeric jira_id alongside the key on every binding, then re-asks by id on a key lookup miss and re-keys the binding to the issue's current key if found, without requiring store migration or affecting Cloud behavior.

The absence probe must be enhanced to attempt id-based resolution before retiring an issue as absent, and must update the binding's key and reverse index in the same operation if the issue is recovered via id.
Bindings created before this change (lacking a recorded jira_id) must degrade safely without fallback or crash, preserving existing behavior.
The id fallback must not fire during normal key resolution; the fix is correct under all three possible readings of what a stale key returns (200-with-new-key, 301, or 404).
